verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a CLI with `--json` output that can be scripted from cron or agents, and agents that work through approved tasks one at a time on a cadence. Nothing documents a native bulk operation, such as approving, triaging, updating or closing many items in one action. Scripting the CLI to loop over items is a developer building block or user-side workaround, not the product's own bulk capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
